b: Carlos Santana has announced a string of North American tour dates for next year.
A total of 15 shows have been announced as part of the PRS artist’s Planet of Free Will Global Tour. They will kick off at the Highland Yaamava Theater, CA on February 23, 2027.
There will be a trio of shows in San Francisco, and a night at New York’s iconic Radio City Hall, before the tour leg wraps up in Atlantic City on April 10.
He will then jet off to the other side of the Atlantic, beginning a European run at The O2 in London before traveling through mainland Europe.
The North American shows are sandwiched between a 16-concert residency at Las Vegas House of Blues, taking place between January 20-31, and May 12-23.
It’s set to be a busy year for the maverick virtuoso, whose soulful playing has shifted over 100 million records across a colorful career.

“Our intention, motives and purpose is to awaken a deeper awareness that this is the Planet of Free Will, and that each of us has the power to choose unity over division, harmony over conflict, and love over fear,” Santana says.

“At every Santana concert, we bring and share unity, harmony, and oneness with every note and we remind everyone that we have the free will to choose a higher consciousness and live for the highest good of all."
Tickets are on sale now via Tickmaster.
